intended_use: initial real printed-region OCR grounding and matched-decoder development, conditional on publisher-provided region boxes

preprocessing.unit: publisher valid_line words grouped by row_id within their annotated field
preprocessing.label: original word texts in publisher order joined with one ASCII space; preserve case, Unicode, punctuation and spelling
preprocessing.crop: axis-aligned union of source quadrilaterals, floor/ceil plus 2-pixel margin, clamped to original image
preprocessing.missing_row_id: retain as an explicitly flagged publisher field region, not a certified physical line
preprocessing.invalid_quad_or_text: record explicit exclusion and retain original annotations
preprocessing.model_input_boundary: image pixels and previous target bytes only; IDs, categories, annotations and current/future labels remain outside the predictor
preprocessing.teacher_forcing: ids = [BOS] + list(text.encode('utf-8')) + [EOS]; inputs = ids[:-1]; labels = ids[1:]; padded targets use ignore_index

checks: exact crop overlaps and conflicting labels
near_duplicate_rule: 64-bit difference-hash Hamming distance <= 2 across different receipts; candidates for review, not automatic deletion
split_policy: preserve original receipt-level train/validation assignments; do not resplit crops
deduplication_policy: content-address crop bytes to save storage; preserve every source row and report duplicates/conflicts
test_policy: no TEST shard/image/annotation payload opened by this run; public-web example exposure and pretrained-model contamination remain unaudited
scientific_qualification: source bytes and software checks do not replace independently signed source/outcome/reward/ACL prefit evidence
